name: keyboard
evidence: checksimulation: one byte for each SDL key, not zero while the key is down. The Linux client names the symbol keyboard

name: prevkeyboard
evidence: checksimulation: the keyboard bytes of the last tick. The Linux client names the symbol prevkeyboard

name: chatmessage
evidence: checksimulation counts down the timer of each message. createmessage and frame_drawmessages use them. Records of 0x98 bytes

name: render_depth_bits
evidence: main: the depth bits of the window, from the depthbits option

name: render_stencil_bits
evidence: main: the stencil bits of the window, from the stencilbits option

name: gl_context
evidence: main: the OpenGL context of the window

name: player_marks
evidence: gameloop writes -2 for each of the 256 players at the start. No code reads it
